#{Dynamically penalize a guaranteed fraction of highest-utility tour edges identified via an adaptive top-quantile threshold, scaling the penalty proportionally to tour edge costs to ensure a controlled and consistent escape perturbation.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    
    n_edges = len(local_opt_tour)
    # Guarantee a controlled perturbation diameter by selecting at least 1 edge and up to top 12.5% of edges
    k = max(1, int(np.ceil(0.125 * n_edges)))
    
    # Deterministic top-k selection via partition to avoid sorting overhead
    threshold = np.partition(utilities, n_edges - k)[n_edges - k]
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    
    # Ensure exactly k edges are penalized in case of duplicate utilities
    selected_indices = np.where(selected_mask)[0]
    if len(selected_indices) > k:
        selected_indices = selected_indices[:k]
        
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_indices]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_indices]
    
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    penalty = 0.3 * avg_edge
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalty
    
    return updated_edge_distance
